issues.description: `Book.title` is declared as `private` in the solution (`private let title: String`), but `Client.main()` prints `book.title`. This would not compile, and it also conflicts with the problem statement describing `Book` as consisting of `title` and `author` fields that are needed for printing the inventory.
issues.suggestedFix: Make `Book.title` accessible where it is used (e.g., change to `let title: String`). If you want to keep storage private, add a non-private computed property/accessor (e.g., `var title: String { _title }`) and update the stored property name accordingly.
